units.passage: Model the behavior they expect to see from their students;
units.policy: Instructors are encouraged to model the behavior they expect to see from their students.
units.why: Instructors are encouraged to "Model the behavior they expect to see from their students", i.e. model responsible use. P112.

units.passage: My Use of Generative AI: I will model appropriate Generative AI usage by clearly disclosing when I use it and why.
units.why: The instructor "will model appropriate Generative AI usage," teaching responsible use by example (P112).

units.passage: Researchers should reinforce with their mentees (undergraduate students, predoctoral students, and postdoctoral trainees) on the appropriate use of AI.
units.why: "Researchers should reinforce with their mentees ... the appropriate use of AI" frames mentoring as teaching responsible use (P112).
units.fit_note: Mentors reinforce appropriate AI use with mentees; not framed as modeling by example.

units.passage: Such instruction should include modeling responsible, discipline-specific use and discussing the strengths and limitations of GenAI, paying particular attention to inaccuracies, bias, and ethics.
units.why: Instruction should include "modeling responsible, discipline-specific use". Instructors model responsible use: P112.
units.fit_note: Coder A (P112): Also covers discussing inaccuracies, bias and ethics. / Coder B (P112): Sentence also asks instructors to discuss strengths, limitations, inaccuracies, bias and ethics.

units.passage: Faculty can model self-reflective, responsible, and ethical AI practices for their students as well as their colleagues.
units.why: 'Faculty can model self-reflective, responsible, and ethical AI practices' frames instructors' own AI use as modeling for students and colleagues, P112.

units.passage: Modelling responsible AI use with students when use is appropriate for the course context.
units.why: "Modelling responsible AI use with students when use is appropriate" has instructors show responsible use, P112.

units.passage: Model ethical disclosure practices for students
units.why: "Model ethical disclosure practices for students" makes faculty disclosure an example for students, so P112.

units.passage: This critical stance is essential for maintaining academic standards and modeling responsible use for students.
units.why: "This critical stance is essential for maintaining academic standards and modeling responsible use for students" ties verification to modeling, P112.

units.passage: Model curiosity and critical evaluation to demonstrate that being a learner means knowing when to seek assistance, when to question results, and when to take back control of the process.
units.why: Instructors should 'Model curiosity and critical evaluation' to show 'when to seek assistance, when to question results'. This is instructors modelling responsible AI use, P112.
units.fit_note: The modeling is of learner habits generally, not explicitly of the instructor's own AI use.

units.passage: An excellent way of promoting appropriate AI use is to model it. For example, ensure that you are following ethical practices for AI use in your own course. If you use AI to help draft an assignment description or a paragraph in your syllabus, be sure to cite it.
units.why: 'An excellent way of promoting appropriate AI use is to model it', e.g. citing AI used to draft an assignment: P112 (instructors model responsible use).

units.passage: Make clear what your policies are regarding Gen AI use in your course. Expectations for ethical and responsible use should always be emphasized, as well as modeled by the instructor. Lead by example, by demonstrating best practices when developing your course.
units.why: "Expectations for ethical and responsible use should always be emphasized, as well as modeled by the instructor" asks instructors to model responsible use, so P112.

units.passage: Model this behavior for students in your own work.
units.policy: Promote ethical AI use, including respecting intellectual property and avoiding plagiarism. Model this behavior for students in your own work.
units.why: 'Model this behavior for students in your own work' asks faculty to model responsible use (P112).
units.fit_note: Also asks for ethical use, IP respect and avoiding plagiarism generally.
